A genuinely well-made, well-designed, and fun game. It's clear that a lot of thought and testing went into Chained Together. The physics are predictable, not floaty or loose like a lot of platformers I've tried to play. Multiplayer and co-op are both highly enjoyable and worth playing. A terrific game, even if you're not normally a fan of platformers (I for one am uniquely trash at them and don't seek them out), this one might surprise you with how nice it is to play.

Chained Together is a hilarious exercise in cooperative frustration where you truly become the architect of your own pain. The variety in level design keeps the climb fresh, but the real challenge lies in your group's ability to sync jumps and movements perfectly.

While it is technically possible to finish solo, the game shines as a must-play multiplayer experience. Playing with friends via voice chat turns every misstep into a comedy of errors, making it the perfect way to test your patience, and maybe test your friendship along the way.
